activity.export.privacy.private: The file isn't encrypted. Each row has its transaction's ID, so whoever has it can find every one on the chain. It ties your private payments, your private sessions and your Lovejoin boxes to each other and to your public account, and shows which Seedelf each payment went to. Give it only to someone you'd show all of that.

create.phrase.note: Write these 24 words on paper, in order, and keep it somewhere safe. They are the only way to restore this wallet. Anyone who has them can take your funds.
create.phrase.onlyHere: This phrase restores your Seedelfs only in Seedelf Wallet. Other Cardano wallets will show your public account and nothing else.
create.phrase.title: Your recovery phrase
create.phrase.warn.neverCopy: Don't copy the phrase into a screenshot, a chat, an email or a cloud note, and never type it into a website.
create.wordMismatch: Word {{number}} doesn't match. Check your written copy.

destination.privacy.hintSeedelf: A Cardano address, an ADA Handle like $name, or a Seedelf's whole name. Looking up a handle tells Koios which one.
explorer.warning.account: Opening this on Cardanoscan tells that site, and your browser history, that this account is yours.
explorer.warning.transaction: Opening this on Cardanoscan tells that site, and your browser history, that this transaction is yours.
explorer.warning.transactions: Opening these on Cardanoscan tells that site, and your browser history, that these transactions are yours.
format.ada.notANumber: Enter an amount in ADA, like 25 or 12.5.
format.ada.tooMuch: That's more than all the ADA there is: 45 billion ₳.
format.ada.tooPrecise: ADA has at most 6 decimal places (0.000001 ₳ is one lovelace), so the extra digits were dropped.
format.commaNote: Use a point for decimals, like 12.5. A comma only groups thousands, like 1,000.
handleWarning.note_one: {{names}} is an ADA Handle. In a private balance, anyone who pays it from another wallet pays the Seedelf contract with nothing to say whose the payment is, so anyone can take it. Keep handles in a public account.
handleWarning.note_other: {{names}} are ADA Handles. In a private balance, anyone who pays one from another wallet pays the Seedelf contract with nothing to say whose the payment is, so anyone can take it. Keep handles in a public account.
handleWarning.returning_one: {{names}} is an ADA Handle, and this return brings it into your private balance. In a private balance, anyone who pays it from another wallet pays the Seedelf contract with nothing to say whose the payment is, so anyone can take it. Once it's back, make it public to your public account.
handleWarning.returning_other: {{names}} are ADA Handles, and this return brings them into your private balance. In a private balance, anyone who pays one from another wallet pays the Seedelf contract with nothing to say whose the payment is, so anyone can take it. Once they're back, make them public to your public account.

home.handles.warn.inPrivate_other: The handles {{names}} are in your private balance. Anyone who pays them from another wallet pays the Seedelf contract with nothing to say whose the payment is, so anyone can take it.

home.privacy.mintFirst: Create your Seedelf before making money private: then what you make private isn't tied to it.

leftOut.leaves_other: Max leaves {{count}} UTxOs where they are:

leftOut.tokensWait: A token it holds would add up to more with the rest than one output can hold, so it waits for the next payment.
lock.idle: Nothing has been clicked or typed for a while.
lockFailed.warn.message: The wallet couldn't lock: {{message}} Try again. Closing the browser always locks it: it forgets your keys when it closes.
moveIn.maxNote: Everything except the fee and what the tokens you keep need. Your collateral and any UTxOs you locked stay put.
moveIn.maxNoteRewards: Everything except the fee and what the tokens you keep need, staking rewards included. Your collateral and any UTxOs you locked stay put.
moveIn.note: Move ADA, and any amount of your tokens, from your public account into your private balance.
moveIn.privacy.links: Making money private links your public account to the new private UTxOs, but not to any Seedelf name.
moveIn.review.note: The new UTxOs are locked to fresh copies of your Seedelf key's register. It takes about a minute for the network to confirm them.
moveIn.review.title: Review making it private
moveIn.tooMuch: That's more than the {{amount}} ₳ available in your public account.
network.label: Network
network.mainnet: Mainnet: Cardano's real network. ADA here is real money.
network.privacy.preprod: Preprod: Cardano's test network, for trying the wallet out with a recovery phrase you don't use on mainnet: the same phrase has the same keys on both networks, so anyone comparing them can tell they're one wallet's. ADA here is test ADA, with no value.
network.testStrip: Preprod, Cardano's test network: ADA here is test ADA, with no value.
receive.address.label: Receive address
receive.handles.note_one: A wallet paying this handle pays the address holding it: this account. A handle is as public as the address.
receive.handles.note_other: A wallet paying one of these pays the address holding it: this account. A handle is as public as the address.
receive.handles.title: Your ADA Handles
receive.note.fund: Anything that can pay a Cardano address can fund this wallet: scan the code from a phone wallet, or copy the address.
receive.privacy.publicAddress: This is an ordinary Cardano address: anyone can see what it receives. To be paid privately, give out one of your Seedelfs' names instead.
receive.privacy.seedelfName: A Seedelf's name is public, and linked to whatever paid to create it. What's paid to it isn't.
receive.qr.label: QR code of the receive address
receive.seedelfs.locked: Locked with it: Remove gives it back
receive.seedelfs.none: People pay a Seedelf's name, and you don't have a Seedelf yet. Create one first: your public account pays for it.
receive.seedelfs.note: Give out a Seedelf's whole name: tags aren't unique. Anyone with Seedelf Wallet can pay it, and nobody can tell the payment is yours.
receive.seedelfs.title: Your Seedelfs
receive.stake.label: Stake address
receive.title: Receive
recipients.atMost: A payment pays at most {{number}} recipients.
reset.note: Without the password, the only way back in is your recovery phrase. This deletes the wallet from this browser, then you restore it from the phrase and choose a new password. The phrase brings back your public account, your private balance and your Lovejoin boxes. What private sessions' one-time accounts hold doesn't show after a restore yet. If a payment may still go through, an encrypted record of it stays in this browser: restoring this same phrase here watches it again, and making or restoring another wallet deletes that record.
reset.title: Restore from your phrase
reset.warn.noPhrase: If you don't have your recovery phrase, stop here. Deleting the wallet without it loses your funds for good.
restore.note: Enter your recovery phrase. A phrase from Lace, Eternl or Yoroi also works: its first account becomes this wallet's public account.
restore.pasteTip: Tip: paste the whole phrase into any box.
restore.title: Restore a wallet
review.nothingSent: Nothing is sent until you press Send
send.note.label: Note (optional)
send.note.privacy.hint: {{used}}/{{max}}. Anyone can read it, for good.
send.note.privacy.hintSeedelf: {{used}}/{{max}}. Anyone can read it, for good, and it could say whose Seedelf this pays.
send.privacy.open: This pays from your public account in the open: anyone can see it came from you. To pay without that link, make the money private and send it from there.
send.privacy.openSeedelf: This pays from your public account in the open: anyone can see it came from you and went to a private balance, though not whose. To pay without that link, make the money private and send it from there.
send.privacy.openSeedelfSeveral: This pays from your public account in the open: anyone can see it came from you and went to a private balance, though not whose. Paying several at once also shows they were paid together. To pay without that link, make the money private and send it from there.
send.privacy.openSeveral: This pays from your public account in the open: anyone can see it came from you. Paying several at once also shows they were paid together. To pay without that link, make the money private and send it from there.
send.privacy.otherAccount: This is your own Account {{number}}. It's an ordinary Cardano payment, so anyone can see your two accounts paying each other and tell they're one wallet's. Sending from your private balance instead would avoid that.
send.review.confirmTime: It takes about a minute for the network to confirm.
send.review.onlyOwnerEach: Only the owner of each Seedelf can spend the payment, and it can't be linked to their Seedelf by looking at the chain.
send.review.onlyOwnerThis: Only the owner of this Seedelf can spend the payment, and it can't be linked to their Seedelf by looking at the chain.
send.warn.ownAccount: This is your own public account: the payment comes back to it, less the fee.
serviceAccess.stillRefused: Chrome still isn't letting the wallet reach Koios.
serviceAccess.warn.blocked: Chrome isn't letting Seedelf Wallet reach Koios, where it reads Cardano, so your balances can't load and nothing can be sent. That happens when the wallet's site access is limited in Chrome's extension settings.
setPassword.hint.fair: Fair. A few more characters or words would help.
setPassword.hint.weak: Weak. Longer is stronger: a few random words work well.
setPassword.note: The password unlocks the wallet in this browser. It encrypts your recovery phrase here; it can't recover your funds anywhere else. Use at least {{min}} characters.
settings.language.label: Language
settings.language.warn.unchecked: Every language is in the wallet already: choosing one asks nobody anything. Spanish and Japanese have not been checked by a native speaker, so a warning may read oddly — English is always here to compare against.
startup.reloadNote: Reloading closes the wallet's windows. Your wallet is kept; you unlock it again with your password.
startup.title: The wallet couldn't start
transfer.pasteName: Paste the whole name the recipient gave you. Tags aren't unique, so the name is what counts.
transfer.privacy.timing: Sending right after making money private is easy to match by timing: the two sit close together on chain.
transfer.review.noteEach: Only the owner of each Seedelf can spend the payment, and it can't be linked to their Seedelf by looking at the chain. Send asks giveme.my to lend the collateral, then submits. It takes about a minute for the network to confirm.
transfer.review.noteThis: Only the owner of this Seedelf can spend the payment, and it can't be linked to their Seedelf by looking at the chain. Send asks giveme.my to lend the collateral, then submits. It takes about a minute for the network to confirm.
transfer.tooMuch: That's more than the {{amount}} ₳ in your private balance.
transfer.warn.ownSeedelf: This Seedelf is yours. Paying it moves money in a circle and costs a fee.
transfer.warn.toSelf: This Seedelf is yours: the payment comes back to your private balance, less the fee.
transfer.warn.toSelfSeveral: One of these Seedelfs is yours: its payment comes back to your private balance, less the fee.
unlock.forgot: Forgot password? Restore from your phrase
unlock.title: Welcome back
unlock.waiting.more_one: {{origin}} and {{count}} other site are asking for Seedelf Wallet. Unlock to see what they ask.
unlock.waiting.more_other: {{origin}} and {{count}} other sites are asking for Seedelf Wallet. Unlock to see what they ask.
unlock.waiting.site: {{origin}} is asking for Seedelf Wallet. Unlock to see what it asks.
unlock.waiting.unknown: A site is waiting for Seedelf Wallet. Unlock to see what it asks.
unlock.warn.trap: The wallet's core stopped working, so the wallet locked itself and let go of your keys. Unlock it to carry on.
utxos.collateralNote: Your collateral: put up by transactions that run a script, and otherwise kept. Reclaim it in Settings, under Collateral.
utxos.holdsSeedelf: It holds one of your Seedelfs.
utxos.lock.lock: Lock: keep it out of payments
utxos.lock.locked: Locked: tap to spend it again
utxos.lockNote: Lock a UTxO to keep it out of every payment from this balance, Max included.
utxos.lockNoteSite: A site's transaction can't use a locked UTxO either: the wallet refuses to sign it.
utxos.mixHolding: A mix through Lovejoin is being sent from this account ({{sent}} of {{total}} sent). The UTxOs it spends, and its change, are held by the mix: they're left out here and from your balance until it's all sent.
utxos.onlyRemoveSpends: Only removing the Seedelf spends it.
utxos.privacy.cameFrom: Came from: {{history}}. Payments try to keep money with different histories apart, since spending them together ties them to each other, and say when they can't. Lock it to keep it out of payments altogether.
utxos.privacy.onlyThisWallet: Only this wallet can tell these are yours. Looking one up on an explorer tells that site which UTxO you care about.
utxos.state.locked: Locked: left out of every payment.
utxos.warn.someUnspendable_one: One UTxO here holds a reference script the wallet can't spend, marked Can't spend. Anyone can send one.
utxos.warn.someUnspendable_other: {{count}} UTxOs here hold a reference script the wallet can't spend, marked Can't spend. Anyone can send one.
utxos.warn.unspendablePrivate: It holds a reference script, which the wallet can't spend yet: no payment takes it, and it isn't counted in your private balance. It stays yours.
utxos.warn.unspendablePublic: It holds a reference script that Koios doesn't give the wallet, so the wallet can't price spending it: no payment takes it, Max included.
withdraw.leftLimit: a transaction takes {{max}} at most, and never a token adding up to more than one output can hold.
withdraw.leftTokens_one: it holds a token that would add up to more with the rest than one output can hold.
withdraw.leftTokens_other: each holds a token that would add up to more with the rest than one output can hold.
withdraw.left_one: {{count}} private UTxO stays for another payment:
withdraw.left_other: {{count}} private UTxOs stay for another payment:
withdraw.maxNote: Everything in your private balance, up to 20 UTxOs at once, with every token, less the fee. Spending them together ties them to each other.
withdraw.maxNoteLocked: Everything in your private balance, up to 20 UTxOs at once, with every token, less the fee. Spending them together ties them to each other. UTxOs you locked stay put.
withdraw.privacy.linksBack: Making money public where it came from links it back. Send it somewhere else, or keep it private.
withdraw.privacy.linksBackSeveral: Making money public where it came from links it back. Send it somewhere else, or keep it private. Addresses paid in one payment can be seen to be paid together.
withdraw.review.note: Send asks giveme.my to lend the collateral, then submits. It takes about a minute for the network to confirm.
withdraw.review.title: Review the payment
withdraw.warn.ownAccount: This is your own {{whose}}. Making money public here links it back to it, and to whoever made it private.
